tasks.short: Prepare renewable resource management plans from ecological evidence and agreed objectives.

steps.what: Define renewable resource objectives, evidence limits, and management options
Prepare a management plan draft from selected evidence and options

loop.purpose: Draft the explanatory sections of a resource plan
loop.input: Scientist selected evidence and versioned planning brief
loop.output: Draft with source anchors and unresolved questions
loop.check: Biologist checks each ecological claim, uncertainty, and option against the selected evidence
loop.stop: One revision; unsupported passages return to manual drafting
loop.why_not_simpler: A document template supplies headings but cannot explain site specific ecological tradeoffs

steps.what: Choose management measures and approve the completed plan

tasks.design: Use a {DOCS} template and a bounded drafting assistant on selected studies. The biologist defines objectives, resolves ecological tradeoffs, and approves the exact plan before management receives it.
tasks.previous_blocker: Plans combine local evidence with competing objectives that a fixed form cannot resolve.
tasks.enabler_now: Source restricted drafting can produce explanatory text for a scientist to check.
tasks.still_hard: Uncertain ecosystem responses and stakeholder priorities determine the actual measures.
tasks.human_edge: The biologist takes responsibility for recommendations under ecological uncertainty.
tasks.altitude: Spend slightly less time turning decisions into prose while retaining plan ownership.

reach.learn: Which assumptions would change the preferred intervention

evidence.claim: Benchling drafts study reports from laboratory information; this demonstrates scientific drafting capability, not validated resource planning.
A bounded assistant could reduce the prose preparation portion of resource planning after scientist review.

assumptions: The boundary is preparing a plan; field surveys and implementing measures are separate work.
The biologist produces the planning brief in s1, recording objective, site, study version, source locator, constraint, and unresolved question; all selection and capture time is within its 35% share.
Native document templates and reusable headings are configured first; an assistant only drafts evidence based explanations.
Missing sources or contradictory evidence require manual drafting, never inferred management limits.
unknowns: How much current drafting repeats previously agreed structure
Whether selected studies may enter the chosen workspace
research_questions: On two completed plans, does source restricted drafting reduce total time after ecological review without adding unsupported claims?

already_counted.description: Evidence selection and planning brief capture

incremental.description: Maintain source restrictions and review failed draft patterns

approvals.approved_version: Exact plan text, measures, evidence versions, scope, and uncertainty statements; any change voids approval

time_saved_range_pct.basis: E1 scenario: B=100 focal hours; R=35+21+35=91; gross 9%, less 4 upkeep gives central net 5%. Range 0-3% allows slower evidence review.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Measure aquatic physical conditions and interpret their relationship to aquatic life.

steps.what: Measure salinity, acidity, light, oxygen content, and other water conditions
Determine relationships between measured conditions and aquatic life

tasks.design: Retain field measurement with calibrated water monitoring instruments in {OTHER}. The biologist interprets the measurements in {DOCS}, considering location, timing, instrument limitations, and aquatic observations.
tasks.previous_blocker: Representative measurements require access to water sites and control of measurement conditions.
tasks.enabler_now: Existing instruments support measurement, but the prompt supplies no additional unattended sensing deployment.
tasks.still_hard: A numerical association does not establish ecological causation or represent the whole water body.
tasks.human_edge: The biologist recognises sampling artefacts and contextual ecological explanations.
tasks.altitude: Keep responsibility for representative measurement and ecological interpretation.

reach.learn: Which handling or timing effects distort readings

evidence.claim: Automated measurement alone does not remove field sampling judgement or ecological interpretation in this task.

assumptions: The baseline comprises field measurement and interpretation, without an invented reporting or rekeying segment.
OTHER denotes calibrated water monitoring instruments; existing digital readings receive no new saving credit.
No machine step or structured input contract is proposed; all observations and interpretation remain counted human work.
No new software is deployed, so incremental software upkeep is zero; ordinary calibration remains within measurement time.
unknowns: Whether current sensors already store measurements
How much travel and site access the task requires
research_questions: Does direct observation show a separate repeated transcription burden after sampling?

already_counted.description: Site measurement, handling, and calibration checks

incremental.description: No additional software or capture process introduced

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B=100, R=65+35=100; gross and net saving 0%, with no incremental process.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Develop pest controls and assess exclusion risks using scientific methods.

steps.what: Assess pest exclusion risks from organism, pathway, and site evidence
Develop pest management and control measures and test scientific adequacy

tasks.design: Keep scientific risk assessment and pest control development with the biologist, using {DOCS} for supporting reasoning. No automatic recommendation or control application is introduced.
tasks.previous_blocker: Pest controls depend on site specific pathways, efficacy, and effects on other organisms.
tasks.enabler_now: Available drafting tools do not establish biological safety or exclusion effectiveness.
tasks.still_hard: Uncertain exposure and unintended ecological effects require investigation and judgement.
tasks.human_edge: The scientist weighs incomplete evidence and designs defensible control measures.
tasks.altitude: Remain accountable for pest risk reasoning and scientifically justified controls.

reach.learn: Which control options create unacceptable ecological exposure

evidence.claim: Document drafting capability alone does not validate pest exclusion risks or control efficacy.

assumptions: This boundary covers developing measures and risk assessment; operational application of controls is separate.
No repeated clerical component is established by the task, so none is invented for savings.
Native document tools remain sufficient for recording reasoning; no new assistant or structured risk flag is proposed.
All evidence appraisal and capture remain human time; no new process creates incremental upkeep.
unknowns: Whether work concerns recurring established pests or novel introductions
What experiments are required for each control option
research_questions: How much observed task time is scientific assessment versus repeated document assembly?

incremental.description: No new system or additional capture duty

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B=100, R=55+45=100; no removed work or incremental overhead, net 0%.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Develop representative biological sampling methods and apparatus.

steps.what: Develop representative sampling methods for plant, animal, aquatic, or soil populations
Develop and trial apparatus for securing representative samples

tasks.design: Develop sampling designs in {DOCS} and trial physical sampling apparatus in {OTHER}. Retain the scientist's assessment of representativeness and practical collection limitations.
tasks.previous_blocker: Sampling equipment and designs must work with actual populations and field conditions.
tasks.enabler_now: Existing planning tools do not demonstrate that a proposed method yields representative samples.
tasks.still_hard: Selection bias, inaccessible populations, and disturbance effects emerge during trials.
tasks.human_edge: The biologist connects statistical intent with practical biological sampling.
tasks.altitude: Own sampling validity from design through apparatus trials.

reach.learn: Which handling constraints undermine sample representativeness

evidence.claim: Designing and trialling representative sampling methods remains scientific and physical work without a demonstrated repeatable digital component.

assumptions: OTHER means physical biological sampling apparatus, not a new software platform.
Routine collection using an established method is outside this method development boundary.
No machine step consumes an assumed representativeness flag; the scientist assesses validity within the counted steps.
Native document tools remain in use; no added workflow means zero incremental upkeep.
unknowns: Which organisms and sample media constrain apparatus
Whether statistical design software is already used
research_questions: Do repeated apparatus trials reveal a stable calculation suitable for a separate deterministic tool?

already_counted.description: Physical apparatus development and validity trials

incremental.description: No additional platform or capture requirement

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

role.altitude: Retain scientific ownership of ecological interventions, representative sampling, and physical measurements.
reach: Learn sampling constraints from biological technicians
Review ecological impacts with conservation scientists
role.ambitious_version: A biologist who spends less time assembling plan prose and preserves rigorous field and ecological judgement.
